about: Which version of the site runs. 'spec' (the default) is exactly what the shared spec requires (specs/001-superintelligence-homepage): the superintelligence feed, grouping, explainable tags, accounts, votes, saves, sources, topic filter, and the admin tools needed to run the site. 'extended' adds John's extra work (notes, reading lists, weekly brief, source suggestions, the capability tracker, project tracker, codebase map, Learn layer and generative UI studio). Choose with SITE_PROFILE=spec|extended. The extended build is also saved as branch feature/snapshot-john-extended-2026-11-07 (docs/snapshots).

spec.about: Matt's shared spec, REQ-001 to REQ-020. The spec lists notes, reading lists, a weekly brief, user-suggested sources and an in-app agent log as out of scope.

extended.about: Everything: the spec plus John's additions, kept for comparison and later use.
